g.text: The theory seam (P7 step 4): a factory gate, an admission at a send, a check at a match
free Th(args) in the constructor (gate 4, TH-4)
Th is Nat, Int, String, Bool or Any?
with the bytes of the builtin identity of Th
read C(sid): decode the identity bytes
TH-1: a builtin decides by shape,
admit each value v_i in order, one reserved unit each,
before any staging or counter bump (TH-5, TH-8)
the first verdict that is not Proven?
store the datum, or fire a waiter with the datum in flight:
the checker checks no datum in flight (TH-6)
read C(sid): decode the identity bytes
the first candidate that matches spatially:
a head, a scan record, a lane head or a join search
the where guard admits the match?
check_match on each stored datum of the match,
with the values that its bind captures (TH-6)
a guard refusal: a scan receive parks, a head blocks,
two or more leases in the transaction (TH-9)?
a step of the plan of the space agent
the config record, or a parked waiter
a failure that aborts the deploy
